blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Jesus was setting out on the road when a man came running up to him. Mark only calls him one who came. Other gospels tell us he was young, and a ruler, and very rich.

verses.text: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him,

segments.speaker: man
segments.text: Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: He ran. He knelt in the dust. This was a man who really wanted an answer.

verses.text: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.

verses.text: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Jesus named the commandments about how we treat other people. The man listened, and he could say yes to every one of them.

verses.text: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And he answered and said unto him,

segments.speaker: man
segments.text: Master, all these have I observed from my youth.

verses.text: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Before Jesus said anything hard to him, Mark tells us that Jesus looked at him and loved him. The hard word came from love.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: There was one thing this man held tighter than anything else. Jesus put his finger right on it. He invited him to let it go and come follow him.

verses.text: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: He did not argue. He did not get angry. He was simply sad. He went away, and the story does not say he ever came back.

verses.text: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

verses.text: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!

verses.text: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: A camel is the biggest animal people in that land knew. The eye of a needle is the smallest opening. Jesus meant something impossible, and his friends understood him.

verses.text: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves,

verses.text: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: That is where Jesus brought them. None of us can get into God's kingdom by being good enough or by giving up enough. It is impossible for people. It is not impossible for God.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: The young man came asking what he could do. Jesus showed him that the real question was what he loved most. Money is not the only thing a heart can hold too tightly. Each of us has something. And the same Jesus who looked at that young man with love looks at us the same way, and still says, come, follow me.

first_reader.note: Written by Claude in the landing session, then Claude's pastor and cultural read.

pastor.note: Faithful to Mark 10:17-27; 'young' and 'ruler' attributed to the other gospels (Matt 19:20, Luke 18:18); no rule that all must sell everything and no claim that wealth damns; the point is v27, with God.

cultural.note: Plain; the rich man shown as sincere and sad, not mocked.
